html: Born in Miletus, she lived in Athens as a foreigner and was the partner of Pericles. Their son, also named Pericles, was later made a citizen by special vote. Comic poets mocked her, and Plato has Socrates credit her with teaching rhetoric. How much of this is true is unclear.
